insight: Its on-device Long-Term Memory captures a rolling ~9 months of work context, so the copilot can answer "what was I working on last week?"
name: Pieces
tagline: On-device AI memory and copilot that recalls your work context.
description: Pieces is a developer-focused AI tool that automatically captures your work context — code snippets, docs, chats, and links — across your apps and surfaces it through a copilot. Its Long-Term Memory engine records a rolling window of activity at the OS level, enabling time-based questions about what you were doing. It runs on-device and air-gapped from the cloud by default, with optional cloud LLMs, and plugs into desktop, VS Code, JetBrains, and the browser.

modelSupport.notes: Choose cloud or local LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, local models) or bring your own key.
